resolution.note: krn state handoff writes ## Merged from git; krn state retro prints the measured skeleton; skills shrink 386 bytes

title: Generate the handoff and retro text from state, tasks and merged PRs
body:
Outcome: the handoff's Resume fields and the retro skeleton are generated from `krn state`, the task record and the merged PRs, as `krn pr body` (t-56eqw8q) does for PR text, and the krn-handoff and krn-retro skills drop the text the generator owns.
Why: cost scan 11-09 put ~$29 on hand-written handoff, retro and PR text; t-56eqw8q shipped only the PR body generator (~$0.10/PR estimated) and left the handoff and retro parts.
Proof: a test renders a handoff from a fixture capsule and task; the skill byte budget in spec/context-budget.json shrinks.
Scope: src/cli, .agents/skills/krn-handoff, .agents/skills/krn-retro, test/cli.

Lesson from the first use (roadmap-rerank PR): krn pr body puts the task's Why under Problem; a PR that also fixes something beyond the task (red main) needs a --problem override or a commit-derived Problem.
